findings.expected: OD-1: a bare answer earns zero unless the official scheme for that question type awards it. The official 2023 P2 Q2 row (report PDF331, rendered) awards 'a=-2 www B1, b=-3 www B1, c=2 www B1' - value marks without wrong working - and additionally 'Allow all the marks if values are seen in the correct place in the formula'. The same page shows the board writes 'B0, M0, A0 ... without any working' where it means to deny bare answers (Q1(b)); it does not for Q2. The WO's own criteria (B1 www 'Correct signed a, without wrong working for it') likewise award a correct value with no wrong working.
findings.actual: Answer-only rule (WO:55) gives a bare coefficient list 0/3 but a bare complete formula 3/3, and labels the split 'owner-binding interpretation' D1-MOD-OD1-LIST (WO:57). OD-1 contains no such ruling, and OWNER-CHECKPOINT.md:14 does not surface it. The declared response_format is 'numeric named coefficients' (WO:7,35), so the default fully correct response scores 0/3 while the same information typed as a formula scores 3/3; the answer-only line contradicts the criterion table.
findings.repair: Either (i) apply the official Q2 exception to correct values in any unambiguous form (list or formula), www, 3/3 - consistent with OD-1 and the criterion table; or (ii) put the list-vs-formula split to Vitalis as an explicit named deviation and, if accepted, rewrite a:B1-B3 to require visible working for list responses. Drop the 'owner-binding' label until Vitalis has ruled.

findings.expected: Accepted-answer sets for every admitted angle are unambiguous. 2025 report PDF347 says angles must be to 1 dp, 'not round the answer to the nearest whole number'.
findings.actual: D1 accepts exact 60/90 without '.0' but otherwise requires a 1 dp value. Three admitted non-exact angles round to x.0: (3,-1,1) 79.975 -> 80.0 and (3,3,1),(3,3,2) 62.964 -> 63.0. Whether '80' or '63' (nearest whole number, numerically equal to the memo) earns b:A1 is unstated, and a numeric comparator would accept them, contrary to the report. These tuples are not in the frozen fixture set.
findings.repair: State that for non-exact angles b:A1 needs the 1 dp form (80.0, 63.0), and freeze these three tuples with accepted/rejected strings alongside the 15 rounding fixtures.
